open.text: Open the Partner link from your sponsor.

partner.text: Make sure it's the Partner link, not the Client link.

ifme.text: If that's me, you'll find it at MTG tribe dot com slash jet up.

indiv.text: On the sign up form, choose Individual.

type.text: Type your first name, last name, email and a password, using English letters only.

pw.text: Your password needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character, with no spaces.

country.text: Choose your country, then type your cell number without the first zero.

code.text: The country code is already there.

reg.text: Then pass the security check, and tap Register Now.

mail.text: Check your email, and tap the verification link.

links.text: Everything I showed you, plus my links, is at MTG tribe dot com slash jet up.

save.text: Save this video, so it's here when you need it.

pays.text: It pays to pay attention, and take action.

hi.text: Hi, my name is MTG, Your Digital Architect.

pause.text: You can pause any step and follow along with me.

together.text: We're going to do this together, one tap at a time.

share.text: Share it with someone who's ready to start.

o_fin.text: Quick reminder: none of this is financial advice.

o_thanks.text: Thank you for tuning in, and for every like, share, and comment.

o_massive.text: And thank yourself for taking massive action today to change your future!

o_best.text: I wish you nothing but the best, because YOU are the best.

o_see.text: See you on the next one.

n_thanks.text: Thank you for taking the time to watch this video.

n_inthis.text: In this video, I'll show you how to create your Jet Up account, step by step, on your phone.

n_ov1.text: You'll open the Partner link, choose Individual, and type your real name and email.

n_ov2.text: Then you'll create a password, add your country and phone number, and tap Register Now.

n_ov3.text: Finally, you'll verify your email, log in, and check your profile.

s_name.text: Use your real first and last name, exactly as on your ID.

s_pw12.text: Your password can have up to twelve characters, so write it down somewhere safe.

s_tip.text: If it says the email is already registered, use another email, or log in with that one.

s_regok.text: Registration successful! Now check your email.

s_open.text: Open the email from I B Portal, and tap Verify Account.

s_verified.text: Your email is verified. Tap Continue to Login.

s_login.text: Log in with the email and password you just created.

s_in.text: And you're in! Your profile shows Account Type: Partner.

r_intro.text: Let's recap what we covered in this video.

r1.text: You opened the Partner link and chose Individual.

r2.text: You typed your real name and email, and created a password of up to twelve characters.

r3.text: You added your country and phone number, and tapped Register Now.

r4.text: Then you verified your email, logged in, and saw Account Type: Partner on your profile.

x1.text: In the next video, part two, I'll show you how to link Jet Up to TAG Markets.

x2.text: You'll sync your account through Copy X, confirm your TAG Markets email, and log in to your TAG Markets dashboard.

l_ifme.text: If I invited you, go to MTG tribe dot com slash jet up, and tap any Join Jet Up button.

l_other.text: If someone else invited you, use their Partner link instead, so you join their team.

l_every.text: Invited by someone else? Use their link. This video is for every team, so feel free to share it.
